name: solution-architecture
description:
Requirements and architecture for the current engagement.

- requirements-defaults: During a discovery call or before RSCOP and SAD work, walk each NFR category as HIT, MISS, DEFAULT, or ASK, and write docs/<slug>-nfr-discovery.md.
- rscop-analysis: When you have a SOW, discovery notes, or intake, write a Reliability, Security, Cost, Operations, and Performance analysis where every row has a measurable target.
- solutions-architecture-document: When an RSCOP file exists, write the Solutions Architecture Document from it and link the ADRs.
- architecture-decision-records: When a decision needs a durable record, write an ADR with status, supersedes, options, and consequences.
- c4-diagrams: When the deliverable is a C4 model, draw Context and Container, and add Deployment when asked.
- requirements: When you start a feature or new feedback arrives, draft a numbered FR-* and NFR-* spec and stop for a human sign-off.
- astro-elt-contexts: When you design, generate, or review warehouse ELT on Astro, Airflow, or dbt, land the source, transform it, and publish a contract; apply every gate before you write files.
